rmaId.description: The RMA the parcel was opened against; null when the whole parcel was unexpected.

kind.description:
How a received line relates to an RMA. `MATCHED` lines carry the rmaId
they match; `UNEXPECTED` lines have none and raise
`UnexpectedReturnReceived`. There is no third state.
kind.title: LineKind

rmaId.description: The RMA this line matched; absent on an UNEXPECTED line.

inspectedQuantity.description: Present once inspected; never above quantity.

grade.description: The inspection grade of a return line.
grade.title: Grade

reasonCodes.description: Why the grade; present once inspected.
